pcs.pc_description: Comprehend the need, status, scope and types of Childcare Institutions
the essential components of an effective childcare institution, including the physical setup, safety measures, team members

modules.module_title: Aggregate the developmentally appropriate Teaching Learning Material (TLM) and modify as per childcare program

pcs.pc_description: Inculcate Teaching learning material (TLM), Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) concepts and Play-based teaching-learning methods in learning environment
research and explore the various teaching learning materials and equipment which are safe, economical, age appropriate, hygienic, environment friendly, sustainable, easy to use and store.

compile and segregate available ready-made TLM as per the age and developmentally appropriate childcare plan into different categories of development, integrating different types of methodologies to provide an interesting, stimulating and exciting environment for children
Arrange materials and resources required to conduct various learning activities across ages as per TLM
Prepare training calendar in accordance with seasons, occasions, events, festivals, etc.
Ensure inclusion of a mix of individual and group, indoor and outdoor , & simple and complex activities in training calendar
Create resource bank of edutainment by accessing and compiling appropriate digital content
Share links of content with parents to use at home for engaging the children

modules.module_title: Create "Print-rich" and stimulating environment as per TLM

pcs.pc_description: Organize an age and developmentally appropriate learning environment for holistic development of children
create a positive learning environment in a childcare set up
display the charts and edutainment material to create a Print rich environment
segregate different learning or activity corners in the setting where children can explore, make things, experiment and pursue their own interest

modules.module_title: Implement activities for holistic development of children as per TLM covering all domains of Development

pcs.pc_description: Implement the activities providing children with adequate time and opportunity to to develop gross motor skills, fine motor skills, cognitive abilities, creative development, socio emotional development, communication and language development, moral and self-help/adaptive Development according to their age in such a manner that the growth and development of a child could be monitored as well.
observe and supervise children’s activity without over and under protecting them
encourage children to find, use, and return materials independently
Ensure the standard daily routine schedule to be followed by team with respect to hygiene, meals, nap, etc. for each age group

monitor that age and developmentally appropriate routine and schedule for children is followed as stated in the childcare program with respect to assisted daily living activities, sleep, meal, clean environment set-up, etc. for each age group

modules.module_title: Monitor the curriculum's effectiveness and share recommendations to improve child development outcomes

pcs.pc_description: Monitor that the childcare program is smoothly integrated into the day-to-day operations of the center including organizing daily routines, mealtimes, nap schedules, and activities
assess children’s involvement and interest in various activities
track children’s progress and and gather feedback and observations related to necessary changes to optimize learning and development outcomes
monitor, record the effectiveness of the program and report to higher authority
adapt educational content, schedules, and daily routines ensuring flexibility while maintaining quality care.

modules.module_title: Ensure provision of balanced meals for children in the centre to promote good health while maintaining high standards of nutritional care

pcs.pc_description: Develop awareness of and sensitivity to cultural differences in dietary practices and needs
Coordinate for ensuring provision of balanced meals for children in the centre to promote good health
Facilitate materials for innovative, nutritious, economical and child friendly dishes as per the meal menu
Supervise that healthy, safe and hygienic food preparation, storage, serving and discard practices are followed at the center
Assess staff is adequately trained and competent in ensuring high standards of nutritional care.
Spread awareness on breastfeeding initiation and promotion techniques
Spread awareness on complementary and bottle-feeding guidelines and techniques
Spread awareness on responsive feeding techniques
Supervise that healthy eating habits / behaviour, self-feeding attitude and value of respect for food is followed in the centre

modules.module_title: Assist in regular nutritional assessments for monitoring the growth and development of children, identifying and addressing any nutritional deficiencies.

pcs.pc_description: Supervise monitoring and recording of children’s growth parameters like height and weight; children’s meal consumption and report the same to parents on daily basis
Record and address concerns regarding children’s food consumption and habits
Communicate with parents about their child’s calorie requirements at home, awareness regarding age-based portion sizes and support in promoting self-feeding practices
Identify and report signs and symptoms of obesity, malnutrition and different macro and micro- nutrient deficiencies to appropriate authority
Assist in provisioning supplementary foods and extra diet plan/support for malnourished children or children with nutritional deficiencies in the center as per directives of higher authority.
Spread awareness on interventions for prevention of malnutrition

modules.module_title: Maintain personal, children, environmental hygiene and sanitation in center

pcs.pc_description: Implement organizational hygiene and sanitation guidelines in center and report breaches/gaps if any
Communicate with parents, emphasizing the importance of sending children to the center clean and hygienic
Monitor staff is following protocols to support cleaning and dressing children as needed, ensuring they always maintain a hygienic standard
Oversee implementation of protocols for maintaining a clean and safe environment within the center
Ensure separate sheets are used for food, play, and rest areas and regularly sanitizing toys and other shared items to prevent the spread of germs
Follow effective waste disposal systems to maintain a hygienic and safe environment for children
Monitor if guidelines for ventilation and air conditioning are followed in the center
Monitor and implement incident reporting mechanism in center
Deal with stress and anxiety during a disease/infection outbreak in the center
Ensure conservation of resources in the center
Utilize teaching aids to promote hygienic practices amongst staff and children

modules.module_title: Monitor self-hygiene, social distancing practices, waste disposal practices and infection control guidelines are followed in center

pcs.pc_description: Ensure Grooming of staff with general and specific etiquette is followed on duty.
Keep a check if staff is vaccinated against common infectious diseases.
Organize medical health checkups of staff periodically and as and when required
Monitor if personal and environmental hygiene is followed in a childcare centre
Monitor provisioning of safe food and drinking water facilities for children and staff in the settings

Supervise if basic personal and workplace hygiene practices are followed in the center such as washing hands, using alcohol-based hand sanitizers, examining office supplies/deliveries and their sanitization, etc.

Supervise if maximal social distancing practices are followed in center and institutionalize alternate ways of carrying out everyday tasks (use of e-payment gateways/online learning/virtual meetings, etc.)
Ensure usgae of PPE at center and supervise if the process of donning, doffing, and discarding them is followed in the center.
Supervise if regular and proper sanitizing of indoor and outdoor work spaces
Monitor if appropriate process of categorization, disposal, transportation, and treatment of waste is followed in the center

modules.module_title: Identify the infectious and other ailments in children and report it timely

pcs.pc_description: Follow prescribed rules and guidelines during any communicable diseases and other ailments.
Identify, record, report and monitor incidents of health issues, allergy episodes, etc. diligently

modules.module_title: Implement policies of center related to health, wellness and immunization domains

pcs.pc_description: Implement and monitor preventive measures as given in center health policy are be adopted by staff to prevent bacterial and viral infections such as by maintaining a clean environment and proper food storage

Follow escalation and reporting matrix as given in center health policy for timely identification, monitoring, raising alarm and reporting of infectious and other ailments of children to authorities and parents.
Measure and interpret anthropometric indicators for growth monitoring accurately through available trackers such as Poshan Tracker
Provide opportunities for physical movements and activities like dance, yoga, athletics, etc. to staff and children

Create a happy experience for children through adult - child-child mindful interactions, age- appropriate activities, welcoming and comfortable environment for strengthening mental, spiritual and emotional health of children.

modules.module_title: Monitor effective care of sick children by team and organize regular health checkups of children and staff

pcs.pc_description: Observe and report sickness or illness of child to higher authority or parents at the earliest
Ensure all provisions and supplies in the sick room/area in the childcare set-up to handle sick children or to seek medical help
Monitor if the right dose of medicines are administered to the baby or toddler on time, as instructed by parents or health professionals
Monitor teams ensuring effective care is provided to sick children
Assist in organizing regular health checkups of children and staff

modules.module_title: Maintain records related to child developmental growth in a development chart or diary or MCP (Mother and Child Protection) Card of the child

pcs.pc_description: Record findings accurately in a development chart or diary or MCP (Mother and Child Protection) Card of the child
Maintain a vaccination record for each child, including dates and vaccine names
Keep a check if records are up-to-date at the center related to growth monitoring, health cards and progress in development

modules.module_title: Observe and report the alarming signs related to developmental growth as per organizational policies and procedures

pcs.pc_description: Inform parents regarding health issues observed and allergy episodes
Remind parents of upcoming vaccination schedules and ensure unvaccinated or partially vaccinated children are promptly reported for follow-ups

modules.module_title: Demonstrate and monitor Child protection, safety, Abuse, First Aid and Emergency Response in center

pcs.pc_description: Ensure indoor and outdoor environment is safe for children in a childcare centre
Monitor safety equipment are in working condition to keep a check on children’s safety indoors and outdoors
Handle emergencies safely and appropriately
Maintain safe and secure environments by following child-proofing measures and health regulations, while also keeping accurate records for each child
Identify signs of child abuse and neglect and implement its prevention measures
Deal with all incidents of child neglect and abuse appropriately, keeping it well-recorded and reported to parents.
Identify the signs of abuse and harassment, accident, injury, pain, and other symptoms of illness and address the same with appropriate authorities
Identify the nature of the emergency and assess the child’s condition
Stay calm and follow first aid procedures
Demonstrate correct technique of providing CPR
Ensure first aid and medication provisioning in the center and ensure that staff is trained to provide the same as and when required
Contact emergency services or the child’s parents, if necessary
Supervise if spaces, furniture and materials are organized to ensure safety of children.
Apply disaster management techniques to deal with institutional emergencies
Keep a check if fire safety management procedure is followed in the center
Document the incident and first aid provided for record-keeping

modules.module_title: Implement child protection policies and safety protocols

pcs.pc_description: Implement the centre and child Protection and safety policy in the centre
Communicate and share centre and child protection and safety policy with children, team, parents and other stakeholders
Conduct regular training sessions of employees on how to prevent and address child abuse.
Maintain and display local emergency numbers as prevalent in region

modules.module_title: Manage day-to-day finances, track expenses, and maintain healthy cash flow

pcs.pc_description: Ensure timely inflows in a childcare centre
Manage petty cash for daily expenses
Reconcile bank statements
Manage day-to-day finances including tracking income, monitoring expenses, and ensuring healthy cash flow
Comply with various statutory compliances like TDS, GST, EPFO, ESI and other applicable acts
Keep financial records organized and easily accessible
Provide support to the chartered accountant for conducting statutory audit and statutory filing like income tax and other returns
Use different softwares for managing finances

modules.module_title: Supervise childcare operations and implementation of policies and standard operating procedures

pcs.pc_description: Implement policies and standard operating procedures for financial management, manpower management, facility management and child management
Develop a duty roster to allocate responsibilities across childcare staff for smooth operations
Maintain timely supply of goods and services needed on regular basis
Manage enquiry calls, visits and admissions of potential families/parents or other stakeholders in the centre.
Organize centre tour of parents on regular basis
Prepare and manage annual plan of holidays, vacation, celebrations, functions, outings etc
Follow up with prospective and interested clients for conversion into enrolment
Ensure timely and regular upkeep and maintenance of childcare centre
Build a cordial relationship with parents, team, vendors, authorities, other stakeholders and local community for effective utilization of the facility.

modules.module_title: Ensure fairness, consistency and calmness in implementing discipline in the centre

pcs.pc_description: Understand behavior in early years and how to effectively manage in a childcare set up.
Deal with children on a positive note
Ensure fairness, consistency and calmness in implementing discipline in the centre
Apply the techniques for effective BCC (Behavior change management)
Communicate rules and boundaries to staff, children and parents in a childcare centre
Display rules and boundaries of team, children and parents at an appropriate location of the centre
Apply natural consequences strategy to deal with inappropriate behavior of the children, team and parents

modules.module_title: Maintain positive relationships with children, families, and community and handle conflicts amongst children and staff

pcs.pc_description: Coordinate for simple and effective engagement strategies to promote childcare center, such as word-of-mouth, website, social media, promotional events, detouring of centers, local promotions, etc
Assist in loyalty programs and personalized services
Build partnerships with external stakeholders like schools, community leaders, workplaces, corporates, etc. for referrals
Manage online marketing and digital platforms, including websites and social media
Contribute in collecting, maintaining and using potential families’ data
Create and disseminate newsletters, brochures, upcoming events, etc.
Ensure transparency during communication about the center’s policies, fees, daily routines, and safety measures
Maintain open and consistent communication with parents, such as providing regular updates on a child’s progress and addressing concerns promptly
Encourage parental involvement in various activities, such as parent-teacher meetings or special events, to strengthen the relationship between the centre and the family

modules.module_title: Maintain all kinds of records to be maintained in childcare including immunization records and MCP card of children

pcs.pc_description: Record data of all potential families /enquiry calls / parents’ visits
Complete the enrolled family’s data along with identification proofs including parent’s profession, child’s medical details, immunization status and any specific concerns like allergies etc.
Keep daily attendance of children either manually or using biometric system
Record daily activities of children including meals taken, nap period, medicines given (if any), washroom visits (in case of infants and toddlers), sudden illness, accident/injury etc.
Record findings accurately in a development chart or diary or MCP (Mother and Child Protection) Card of the child
Remind parents of upcoming vaccination schedules, keep a track of unvaccinated or partially vaccinated children and follow up with them promptly
Share the children’s progress with parents on periodic basis
Maintain the staff’s record of staff’s profile, qualification and experience credentials, appointment letter, performance appraisal, resignation/termination, attendance, leave, salary, etc
Maintain the transporter’s records of driving license, vehicle details including registration, pollution check, police verification, etc.
Keep a check on the record of children availing of transport indicating trip details, caretaker escorting
Maintain all financial records of fee receipts, expense invoices, bank statements, income tax returns, GST, TDS returns, ESI and EPFO payments (if applicable)
Organise records effectively for easy retrieval, storage and discarding.

modules.module_title: Maintain inventory of materials and resources in the centre required to conduct various learning activities across ages

pcs.pc_description: Maintain inventories of all equipment, appliances, furniture, supplies etc in a childcare centre
Follow the fair, standardized and recorded process of vendor identification and procurement
Keep the inventories up to date

pcs.pc_description: Identify red flags of 4 D’s (Defects, Deficiencies, Diseases, Developmental Delays, disabilities and impairments)
Observe and analyze children's behavior, interactions, behavioral patterns and developmental milestones
Document and report observations and findings accurately and systematically

modules.module_title: Sensitized and provide support in early detection for children covering 4 D’s

pcs.pc_description: Provide support in effective screening and early detection to prevent these conditions from progressing to its more severe and debilitating form
Demonstrate use of various simple screening tools and techniques for early detection of these conditions
Communicate concerns with children, parents, other caregivers and professionals effectively
Use and display IEC materials for spreading awareness on simple screening methods and prevention strategies for different D’s.

modules.module_title: Apply simple strategies for handling, caring, supporting, managing children with disabilities, developmental delays and special needs in the center to facilitate their inclusivity

pcs.pc_description: Apply the concept of diversity and inclusion to build an inclusive childcare centre
Support healthcare providers and special educators to implement basic early intervention and management strategies
Follow policies and procedures to implement confidentiality, consent, and ethical practices in childcare esp. with respect to children with special needs with dignity and calmness
Implement and monitor the customized schedule for the differently abled children
Implement age and developmentally appropriate activities for the differently abled children as per the identified disability/impairment and setting clear goals for each child
Monitor the staff while they are handling children with special needs
Monitor the effective execution of customized plans of activities
Orient and sensitize other children to practice inclusion
Address the needs of different abled children and their parents or families
Support in providing the advocacy, counselling, referral and support services to parents of children identified with special needs as per policies and procedures of childcare centre
